name: Student Score Predictor
description: Academic performance prediction with model comparisons, SHAP explanations, and improvement suggestions.
summary: Study and lifestyle inputs feed a model trained on synthetic data. Feature contributions provide explanation context and suggestions, while the app keeps prediction history for comparison.
architecture: A Streamlit form supplies study and lifestyle features to a persisted model pipeline. The repository compares regression candidates and selects Linear Regression. SHAP contributions inform explanations and suggestions; session history preserves prior predictions. Training data is synthetic.

capabilities.name: Score prediction
capabilities.description: Estimate a performance index and grade from study and lifestyle inputs.

capabilities.name: Prediction explanations
capabilities.description: Show model feature contributions and related improvement suggestions.

capabilities.name: Prediction history
capabilities.description: Inspect previous inputs and predicted scores in the app.

stack.usage: Sliders and result panels expose inputs, scores, contributions, and history.
Python loads persisted model artifacts and constructs explanations and suggestions.
DataFrames prepare student features and support exploratory analysis.
Numerical arrays support model feature preparation and calculations.
Linear Regression is the documented selected estimator after candidate comparison.
XGBoost is an evaluated candidate, not the documented selected prediction model.
SHAP explains feature contributions used by result explanations and suggestions.

architectureConnections.description: The selected prediction model is inspected through feature contributions.

evidence.notes: Reviewed repository README and available dependency manifests. Capabilities describe implemented workflows; roadmap items are excluded.
